name: Chijoku no Seifuku 2
source:
The protagonist lost his job because of his lewd behavior with a female co-worker.
He is self-aware of his own sexuality and lewdness, and was finding it hard to live.
Then, he happens to win a sightseeing ticket and decides to visit the regional city of Oribe.
He decided to play around in this town, which had become a tourist attraction due to the construction of a new large-scale amusement casino, and he was determined to spend all of his money in the city.
He was backwardly determined to end his life once he had spent all the money he had.

He took a city sightseeing bus, met a beautiful bus guide "Ootori Fumika", and went to an amusement casino.
In an amusement casino, he met a pretty dealer "Kitashirakawa Yuno".
By chance, he meets an interesting female doctor "Haruoka Kazusa" at a city hospital.
He finds the women fascinating as they go about their daily routines. 

After meeting these three women, the protagonist changes his original purpose and
He decides to live in accordance with his desire and moves to this town.
For starters, he once again joins a city tour guided by "Fumika Otori," and begins to fall under her spell.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1170511&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公因与女同事发生不轨之事而失去了工作。
他深知自己的性情与好色本性，也觉得生活越发难以为继。
这时，他偶然抽中了一张观光旅行券，决定前往地方城市织部。
新建的大型娱乐赌场让这座城市成了观光胜地，他打算在那里尽情玩乐，花光所有的钱。
他消极地作好了打算，等积蓄花尽，便结束自己的生命。

乘坐市区观光巴士时，他遇见了美丽的导游“大鸟文香”，随后来到娱乐赌场。
在赌场里，他结识了可爱的荷官“北白川悠乃”。
一次偶然的机会，又让他在市立医院遇见了颇有意思的女医生“春冈和沙”。
看着这三位女性忙于各自的日常，他渐渐被她们吸引。

与她们相遇后，主人公改变了最初的目的。
他决定顺从自己的欲望活下去，并搬到这座城市。
首先，他再次报名参加了由大鸟文香带领的市区观光团，开始沉醉于她的魅力之中。
